characters.name: Peter Pan
characters.description: A magical boy who can fly and never grows up, living in the enchanted Neverland and leading the Lost Boys on adventures.

characters.name: Wendy Darling
characters.description: A kind and imaginative girl from London who flies to Neverland with Peter Pan and looks after the Lost Boys.

characters.name: Tinker Bell
characters.description: Peter Pan's tiny fairy companion whose magical golden dust lets people fly when they have happy thoughts.

characters.name: Captain Hook
characters.description: A cunning and dramatic pirate captain with a hook for a hand who is Peter Pan's greatest enemy in Neverland.

translations.title: Peter Pan (1953)
translations.description: The Darling children are whisked away by the boy who never grows up to the magical world of Neverland, where they face pirates, mermaids, and wonderful adventures.
translations.history: Peter Pan was created by Scottish author J.M. Barrie, and the story is set in London before the children fly off to Neverland — the famous Kensington Gardens in London inspired the tale.

translations.title: Peter Pan (1953)
translations.description: Ba anh chị em nhà Darling được cậu bé không bao giờ lớn lên đưa đến thế giới kỳ diệu Neverland, nơi họ gặp cướp biển, nàng tiên cá và nhiều cuộc phiêu lưu tuyệt vời.
translations.history: Peter Pan được tác giả người Scotland J.M. Barrie sáng tạo, câu chuyện bắt đầu ở London trước khi bọn trẻ bay đến Neverland — vườn Kensington nổi tiếng ở London chính là cảm hứng cho câu chuyện này.
